title: 第2471章 元流门吴白风第2470章 入魔
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
在陆沉与林天斩激战的同时，宋焱已经带着剩下的那些人抵达了赤盟总部南边的防线前。
说是防线，其实就是一条绵延数十里的山脉，不过山脉的上方已然竖立起了一座宛如高墙般的七彩屏障。
而在那道屏障后，是以雷江横为首的数十名八境强者，此刻他们的眼中不仅有昂扬的战意，也有对陆沉的担忧。
对方这次来了多少人他们是知道的，眼前这些敌人相比于一百万人少说也少了四十万人。
至于少了的那些人去哪了，众人不用想也知道是被陆沉拦住了，这让他们不由得担心起了陆沉的处境。
虽然陆沉的实力极其强悍，但那可是四十万名活生生的修士，哪怕是雷江横也不敢保证自己能在那么多人的围攻下全身而退。
而且，想要对付陆沉肯定离不开八境强者出手，可那些为人所熟知的八境强者几乎一个都没少。
之所以会出现这种情况，要么是像上次那样有大量没见过的八境强者拦住了陆沉，要么是有众人没料到的超级强者加入了战场。
不过柳如意等人此刻也只能在心里祈祷陆沉平安无事，他们现在要以数十人抵挡五十多万的大军，情况属实不容乐观。
虽然他们之中修为最低的都有八境四重的修为，而且每个人都有充足的战斗经验，一人对抗上万名八境以下的修士应该没什么问题。
但关键是对面可是足有数百位八境强者，其中还有宋焱这种八境巅峰的大修士，他们成功拦住对方的可能性几乎没有。
宋焱居高临下地看着眼前的众人，眼中闪过一抹志在必得之色：“诸位，我也不想伤了和气，只要你们肯束手就擒，我保证不会为难你们。”
说罢，他又装出一副忽然想起了什么的模样，继续补充道：“对了，东边现在估计也已经打起来了。
虽然那边的人数是你们占优势，但失去了你们这些中流砥柱，那些尚未完全恢复的伤员恐怕没多少胜算。
只要你们现在以道心起誓效忠于我，我保证事后不会为难你们，还会拿你们当自己人对待。
那样你们不仅可以逃过一劫，也可以赶过去救下一部分门下弟子，岂不是两全其美？”
闻言，雷江横第一时间站了出来：“哼，姓宋的，这种糊弄鬼的话就不用说了，还是手底下见真章吧！”
说着，他直接取出自己的银色长枪，随即周身雷电涌动，一身强悍的气势眨眼间就达到了巅峰。
下一秒，他直接化作一道银白色的雷光，径直朝着宋焱所在的巨型飞舟冲了过去。
他们这边就数他修为最高实力最强，自然也该由他来对付对面修为最高的宋焱。

就在他即将冲到宋焱面前时，一道白色流光忽然从那艘飞舟后方冲了出来，正面与雷江横碰撞在了一起。
随着一股巨大的冲击力扩散开来，两道流光同时向后倒飞出去，几乎是在同时稳住了身形。
众人定睛一看，只见挡住雷江横的是一名长相清秀的白发男子，虽然其样貌十分年轻，但那双眼底的沧桑却表明他并不是个年轻人。
在看清对方的长相后，雷江横的眼中明显多了几分凝重之色：“吴白风，你觉得你是我的对手？”
来人名叫吴白风，就是元流门那位一直不曾露面的二长老，也是一位八境九重大修士。
听到雷江横的问题，吴白风不由得轻笑道：“雷峰主说笑了，我可不是你的对手，但想要拖住你一时半刻还是没什么问题的！”
说罢，他也爆发出了强悍的气势，磅礴的青色元力在他周围流转，强劲的狂风甚至让一些中小型飞舟都晃动了起来。
见状，雷江横不由得皱起了眉头，虽然他很想只身拦住修为最高的宋焱，但他也知道他必须先过吴白风这一关。
而且吴白风说的没错，若是正面硬碰硬他绝对不是雷江横的对手，但想要在眼前这种情况下拖住雷江横也并非难事。
在沉默了一瞬后，雷江横身上的雷光再度暴动起来，然后猛地朝着朝着吴白风冲了过去：“诸位，按照盟主的命令行事！”
面对冲向自己的雷江横，吴白风手掌一拧，数百道凝实的风刃当即朝着雷江横爆射而去。
虽然这些风刃没能阻挡住对方，甚至没能对对方造成哪怕一丁点伤害，但的的确确减缓了雷江横前进的速度。
而且吴白风本就没想过要战胜雷江横，他要的本来就是尽可能地拖延住对方，只要赤盟被覆灭雷江横再厉害也蹦跶不了多久。
若是换了陆沉，在面对这种情况时，绝对会毫不顾忌地冲向人群，然后逼迫对方的强者不得不来阻止他从而斩杀对方。
但那是因为他拥有极强夸张的体魄和破坏力，低阶修士对他造成的伤害虽然不能忽略不计，但也达不到让他受伤的地步。
而雷江横在破坏力方面不弱于陆沉，想要在这数十万人的大军中杀个七进七出并不是什么难事。
但他的体魄没有陆沉那么夸张，一旦被那些人拖延住，他很难在人群中强杀吴白风这种和他修为相当的修士。
念及此，雷江横心底不由得生出一股无奈的感觉：“那小子可真是个怪物，或许他之前说有战胜我的把握不是在吹牛。”
随着雷江横和吴白风战作一团，方千山也爆发出了强悍的气势，手中的大刀直接被火焰包裹了起来：“诸位，我们也不能落后，一起上吧！”
其他修为够格的人倒是没有说话，但也爆发出了全部的气势，然后毫不犹豫地从元力屏障后冲了出去。

值得一提的是，柳如意和封璃烟前段时间也突破到了八境五重的修为，因此也奋不顾身地从屏障后面冲了出去。

content_en:
While Lu Chen and Lin Tianzhan were fighting fiercely, Song Yan had already led the remaining people to the defense line south of the Red Alliance headquarters.
Said to be a defense line, it is actually a mountain range stretching for dozens of miles, but a colorful barrier like a high wall has been erected above the mountain range.
Behind that barrier were dozens of eight-level experts led by Lei Jiangheng. At this moment, their eyes not only had high-spirited fighting spirit, but also concern for Lu Chen.
They knew how many people the other party had come this time. The number of enemies in front of them was 400,000 or less compared to one million.
As for where the missing people went, everyone knew without thinking that they were stopped by Lu Chen, which made them worried about Lu Chen's situation.
Although Lu Chen was extremely powerful, there were 400,000 living monks, and even Lei Jiangheng could not guarantee that he could survive the siege of so many people.
Moreover, if you want to deal with Lu Chen, you will definitely need the help of a strong person from the Eighth Realm, but there are almost no shortage of those well-known strong people from the Eighth Realm.
The reason why this happened was that either a large number of unseen Eighth Realm experts blocked Lu Chen like last time, or a superpower that no one expected joined the battlefield.
However, Liu Ruyi and others could only pray in their hearts that Lu Chen was safe and sound. They now had to resist an army of more than 500,000 people with dozens of people. The situation was not optimistic.
Although the ones with the lowest cultivation among them all have cultivation at the fourth level of the eighth realm, and each of them has sufficient combat experience, it should be no problem for one person to fight against tens of thousands of monks below the eighth realm.
But the key is that there are hundreds of Eighth Realm experts on the opposite side, including Song Yan, a monk at the peak of the Eighth Realm. There is almost no chance that they can successfully stop the opponent.
Song Yan looked down at the people in front of him, with a look of determination flashing in his eyes: "Everyone, I don't want to hurt the harmony. As long as you are willing to surrender, I promise not to embarrass you."
After that, he pretended to have suddenly remembered something, and continued to add: "By the way, there is probably a fight in the east now.
Although you have the advantage in terms of numbers over there, without you, the mainstay, those wounded who have not fully recovered may not have much chance of winning.
As long as you swear allegiance to me with your Taoist heart now, I promise that I will not make things difficult for you afterwards, and will treat you as one of my own.
In that way, not only can you escape, but you can also rush over to save some of your disciples. Isn't it the best of both worlds? "
Hearing this, Lei Jiangheng stood up immediately: "Huh, Song, there's no need to say such nonsense, let's see the real deal!"
As he spoke, he took out his silver spear, and then thunder and lightning surged around him, and his powerful aura reached its peak in the blink of an eye.
The next second, he turned into a silver-white lightning and rushed straight towards the giant flying boat where Song Yan was.
On their side, he has the highest cultivation level and the strongest strength. Naturally, he should be the one to deal with Song Yan, who has the highest cultivation level on the opposite side.
Just when he was about to rush in front of Song Yan, a white stream of light suddenly rushed out from behind the airship and collided with Lei Jiang horizontally.
As a huge impact spread, the two streams of light flew backwards at the same time, stabilizing their bodies almost at the same time.
Everyone took a closer look and saw that the person blocking Lei Jiangheng was a handsome white-haired man. Although he looked very young, the vicissitudes in his eyes showed that he was not a young man.
After seeing the opponent's appearance clearly, Lei Jiangheng's eyes became more solemn: "Wu Baifeng, do you think you are my opponent?"
The visitor's name is Wu Baifeng, the second elder of Yuanliu Sect who has never shown up, and he is also an eighth-level and ninth-level monk.
Hearing Lei Jiangheng's question, Wu Baifeng couldn't help but chuckle and said: "Master Lei Feng is joking, II'm not your opponent, but if I want to hold you back for a while, there's no problem! "
Having said that, he also burst out with a powerful momentum, majestic cyan energy flowed around him, and the strong wind even made some small and medium-sized airships shake.
Seeing this, Lei Jiangheng couldn't help but frown. Although he wanted to stop Song Yan, who had the highest level of cultivation, by himself, he also knew that he had to get through Wu Baifeng first.
And Wu Baifeng was right, he was definitely no match for Lei Jiangheng in a head-on confrontation, but it was not difficult to hold Lei Jiangheng back in this situation.
After a moment of silence, the thunder light on Lei Jiangheng's body rioted again, and then he rushed towards Wu Baifeng: "Everyone, follow the order of the leader! "
Facing Lei Jiangheng who was rushing towards him, Wu Baifeng twisted his palm, and hundreds of solid wind blades immediately shot towards Lei Jiangheng.
Although these wind blades failed to stop the opponent or even cause even a little damage to the opponent, they did slow down Lei Jiangheng's progress.
Moreover, Wu Baifeng had never thought about defeating Lei Jiangheng. What he wanted was to delay the opponent as much as possible. As long as the Red Alliance was destroyed, Lei Jiangheng would not be able to stay alive for long, no matter how powerful he was.
If it were Lu Chen, when faced with this situation, he would definitely rush into the crowd without any scruples, and then force the opponent's strong man to stop him and kill the opponent.
But that's because he possesses extremely exaggerated physique and destructive power. Although the damage caused by low-level monks to him cannot be ignored, it cannot reach the point of causing him injury.
And Lei Jiangheng was not weaker than Lu Chen in terms of destructive power. It was not difficult to kill seven in and seven out of the army of hundreds of thousands of people.
But his physique is not as exaggerated as Lu Chen's. Once he is delayed by those people, it will be difficult for him to kill a monk like Wu Baifeng who is comparable to him in the crowd.
Thinking of this, Lei Jiangheng couldn't help but feel helpless in his heart: "That kid is really a monster, maybe he wasn't bragging when he said he was sure of defeating me before. "
As Lei Jiangheng and Wu Baifeng fought together, Fang Qianshan also burst out with a strong momentum, and the sword in his hand was directly wrapped in flames: "Everyone, we can't fall behind, let's go together! "
The other people with adequate cultivation levels did not speak, but they also burst out with all their momentum, and then rushed out from behind the Yuanli barrier without hesitation.
It is worth mentioning that Liu Ruyi and Feng Liyan also broke through to the fifth level of the eighth realm some time ago, so they rushed out from behind the barrier regardless of their safety.
